entities.name: Immortal Faller
aliases: One Who Sounds in the Deep
entities.description: The immortal messianic savior and first prophet of Monoism in the Edge, believed to be the first person to fall into a supervoid.

entities.name: Monoists
entities.description: Followers of the Faller who observe his descent.

entities.name: Supervoid
entities.description: Voids at whose center the Faller plummets.

entities.name: Zero Point
entities.description: Center of every supervoid where INEVITA awaits.

entities.name: INEVITA
entities.description: The promised future awaiting beyond the Zero Point.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: The thousandth supervoid of the Monoist faith.

entities.name: The Theorem Unending and Final
entities.description: Both the Faller's song and the second volume of Monoist books.

entities.name: The Seeker and the Well
entities.description: Book reportedly authored by the Faller, first volume of The Plummet Record.

events.summary: Monoists scour the Edge for a sign pointing to Sothera.
events.quote: The Monoists have been scouring the Edge for a sign from the Immortal Faller
